dates.name: Dates

build_steps.action: Heat sauté pan over medium-high heat
Toast ciabatta slices until golden brown on both sides
Warm rendered dates in pan until heated through
build_steps.visual_cue: Dates should be glossy and warm to touch

build_steps.action: Warm piquillo peppers

plating.description: Compose on warm plate with ciabatta as base
steps: Place 3 ciabatta slices in triangular pattern on plate
Top each slice with 2 rendered dates
Place piquillo pepper pieces between dates
Finish with parsley chiffonade over top
Drizzle any pan residue around plate
plating.presentation_notes: Rustic, warm presentation. Dates should glisten.

dates.timing_notes: Fire when appetizer call comes. Quick turnaround dish.
common_mods: No bread/GF request - serve dates over greens

fish_curry.name: Fish Curry

crispy_onions.name: Crispy Onions
method: Dredge in flour, shake off excess
Fry at 350°F until golden and crispy (3-4 minutes)
Toss immediately with red chile powder and salt to taste
crispy_onions.storage: Store in airtight container. Good for 2 days.

build_steps.action: Heat curry sauce in small pot to simmer
Heat large sauté pan with oil until shimmering
Season cod with salt. Place skin-side down in pan
build_steps.technique: Press gently with spatula first 30 seconds to prevent curling
build_steps.visual_cue: Skin should be golden and crispy

build_steps.action: Flip cod, cook flesh side
build_steps.visual_cue: Fish should be opaque and flake easily

build_steps.action: While cod finishes, warm eggplant in curry sauce

plating.description: Build in wide, shallow bowl for sauce presentation
steps: Ladle 4 oz curry sauce into center of bowl
Arrange warmed eggplant pieces in sauce
Place cod skin-side up on top of eggplant
Spoon cucumber raita around the perimeter
Garnish cod with cilantro and dill
Top with crispy onions for texture and height
plating.presentation_notes: Cod skin must be crispy and up. Herbs should be fresh and vibrant. Sauce should pool elegantly.

fish_curry.timing_notes: Fire on main call. Cod needs undivided attention - don't walk away.
common_mods: Spice level - add or reduce chile in curry
fish_curry.critical_notes: DO NOT OVERCOOK COD. Better slightly under than over. Skin must be crispy.

prawns.name: Prawns

build_steps.action: Heat sauté pan to high heat
Season prawns with salt, place in dry hot pan
build_steps.technique: Get a good sear, don't move them around
build_steps.visual_cue: Nice char marks, heads turn red

build_steps.action: Add cherry tomatoes to pan, blister
Add shrimp butter, toss to coat
build_steps.technique: Pan should be hot enough that butter foams immediately

plating.description: Rustic, vibrant presentation highlighting the prawns
steps: Arrange prawns on plate with heads facing out
Spoon shatta in small pools around plate
Scatter blistered tomatoes
Drizzle remaining shrimp butter over prawns
Garnish with rose petals for color and aromatics
plating.presentation_notes: Prawns are the star. Heads should look vibrant. Rose petals add elegant touch.

prawns.timing_notes: Hot fire, quick execution. Fire on ticket call.
prawns.critical_notes: Don't overcook prawns - they get rubbery. Should be just opaque.

charred_cabbage.name: Charred Cabbage

build_steps.action: Heat cast iron or plancha to high
Warm rice mix in pot
Place braised cabbage on hot surface, char all sides
build_steps.technique: Don't move too much - let it char properly

build_steps.action: Finish cabbage with brush of oil

plating.description: Composed vegetable-forward plate with multiple textures
steps: Spread poppy seed yogurt in swoosh across plate
Place warm rice mix in center
Position charred cabbage wedge on rice
Dot romesco around plate
Scatter pickled raisins over cabbage
Dust with masala spice
Garnish with fresh dill fronds
plating.presentation_notes: Should look rustic but refined. Char marks visible. Multiple colors and textures.

charred_cabbage.timing_notes: Fire on main call. Char needs high heat and time.
charred_cabbage.critical_notes: Cabbage must be charred properly for flavor. Don't rush.

short_rib_radish_hummus.name: Short Rib with Radish Hummus

build_steps.action: Remove short rib from lowboy, bring to room temp
Heat cast iron to medium-high
Season short rib, sear all sides
build_steps.technique: Get good crust on all sides, especially fat cap

build_steps.action: Warm sumac glaze
Baste short rib with glaze in pan

steps: Spread hummus generously on one side of plate
Slice short rib against grain into 4-5 pieces
Fan short rib slices across hummus
Arrange charred spring onions on plate
Scatter radish and cucumber slices
Distribute red onion, parsley, and mint over everything
Drizzle green tahini across plate
Dust with shabazi and sumac
Spoon any remaining sumac glaze over short rib
plating.presentation_notes: Abundant, mezze-style. Meat sliced properly against grain. Fresh herbs bright and plentiful.

short_rib_radish_hummus.timing_notes: Fire 15 min before other entrees due to sear time. Short rib needs attention.
common_mods: No onions - omit red onion and spring onion
short_rib_radish_hummus.critical_notes: Short rib MUST be room temp before cooking. Slice against grain or it's chewy. Don't overcook - should be medium-rare to medium.

porterhouse.name: Porterhouse Steak

build_steps.action: Remove steak from lowboy 30 min before cooking
Season generously with salt and green peppercorn
Ensure grill is at proper temp (500-600°F)
Place steak on hottest part of grill
build_steps.technique: Don't move it - let it sear

build_steps.action: Rotate 90 degrees for crosshatch marks
Flip steak, repeat process
Check temp: 120°F for rare, 130°F for medium-rare
Rest steak on board, top with peppercorn butter

plating.description: Classic steakhouse presentation with Middle Eastern accents
steps: Slice steak by cutting meat off both sides of bone
Slice strip and tenderloin against grain into 1/2 inch slices
Reconstruct steak on platter with bone in center
Spoon labneh on one side of plate
Drizzle tomato coriander sauce on other side
Arrange confit garlic cloves around steak
Dust entire plate with black lime powder
Pour any resting juices over sliced meat
Top with any remaining peppercorn butter
plating.presentation_notes: Dramatic presentation. Meat should glisten. Perfect medium-rare throughout. Bone adds theater.

porterhouse.timing_notes: Fire early - needs 30 min room temp + 18 min cook + 8-10 min rest. Total 56 min from fire to pass.
common_mods: Temp requests: rare (120°F), MR (130°F), M (140°F), MW (150°F), W (160°F)
No butter - use olive oil instead
porterhouse.critical_notes: THIS IS THE PRESTIGE DISH. Perfect execution required. Must rest full time. Slice properly against grain. Don't serve over medium unless requested.
